rows.note: The test reads the schema file and checks $id and $schema. validate_session_json checks one instance and does not open a path.
The test compares required sets, property sets, and enums with the canonical parser. validate_session_json checks one instance. Recording those names in facts is not that comparison.
The test searches canonical.py and the schema file for vendor words. validate_session_json does not read source text.
The test checks oneOf refs, then required and known keys on each line of a fixture, and it does not run one schema result for one document.
The test checks key sets on a fixture and then parse_session. validate_session_json does not parse a Session. One accepted document is not that pair of asserts.
get_session_schema_path and load_session_schema open the schema file and the missing-file case raises FileNotFoundError. validate_session_json does not open a path.
The test expects SchemaError when to_canonical_json receives bytes, a set, or another unserializable object. That is not one schema result.
